Privacy.title: Privacy
Privacy.subtitle: How ELITEZ handles your data – clearly and briefly.
Privacy.betaNotice: The app is in a test phase. This page describes how we handle data during testing. Full terms will be published before the official launch.
Privacy.operatorPending: The data controller is the operator of the ELITEZ club. Full company details will be added before the official launch.
Privacy.contactForm: You can also reach us with any question or request via the

data.title: What data we process
data.body:
• Account: email and password (stored encrypted, nobody can see it).
• Profile: username, name, country, city, “About me” and profile photo – all filled in by you.
• Garage: vehicles, their photos, description and mods.
• Event applications: selected vehicle, phone, email and message to the organizer.
• Feedback you send us.

purpose.title: Why we process it
purpose.body: To provide your account, garage and event applications, so the organizer can handle applications and contact you, to send you emails about your application status and organizer messages about events you applied for, and to improve the app during testing. We don't send marketing emails.

visibility.title: Who can see the data
visibility.body:
• Anyone can see public profiles and public vehicles.
• Only you can see a private profile and private vehicles.
• The organizer of an event you apply for sees the application details and the entered vehicle (even a private one) – only for selecting participants.
• The app administrator sees data to the extent necessary for operation and troubleshooting.
Your email and phone are never public.

storage.title: Where the data is stored
storage.body: Database and photos: Supabase, EU data centre (Frankfurt). Website: Vercel. Sending emails: Resend, EU data centre (Ireland). We don't sell or share data with other companies.

photos.title: Photos
photos.body: When uploaded, photos are resized and hidden data (e.g. the GPS location where they were taken) is removed. Licence plates must not be readable on vehicle photos.

beta.title: Test phase
beta.body: During testing we may need to change or delete some data. After the test you can ask us to delete your account and all your data.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You have the right to access, correct and erase your data, restrict processing, data portability and the right to object. You can edit or delete most data yourself in the app; ask us for the rest. You can also lodge a complaint with the Czech Data Protection Authority (uoou.gov.cz).

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.body: We only use essential cookies that keep you signed in. No advertising or tracking cookies.

age.title: Age
age.body: Only people aged 16 or over can create an account.

promo.title: Use of photos and content to promote the club
promo.body: When signing up (and existing members once), you agree to the use of photos and content published on your profile for presentation and promotional purposes of ELITEZ CLUB, including sharing on social media. This only covers content that is publicly visible on the website (public profile, public cars, portfolio). We never use private content. We store when you agreed and to which version of the text. The consent is a condition of membership – if you no longer agree, write to us and we'll delete your account; content already shared will be removed from the club's channels where possible.

Qr.intro: Print a sticker for your car window. At a meet people scan it with their phone and land right on your garage or car – they can give a turbo and follow you.
